name: crypte-pr
description: Opens the pull request towards main (squash, updated by merge) then answers the reviews and the checks until green.

steps.prompt: Open (or reuse) a pull request towards the main branch with the title: {{title}}. Repository discipline: squash merge, updated by merging main (never a rebase and never a force-push on the branch), the `hold` label keeps a PR out of the queue (do not add it unless asked). Save {"url": "..."} in .kiro/workflow-output/pr.json. End with send_message severity success with the PR URL.
